sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "horses" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "call_name" TEXT NULL, "birth_date" TEXT NULL, "birthday_reminder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("birthday_reminder" IN (0, 1)), "sex" TEXT NULL, "breed" TEXT NULL, "color_markings" TEXT NULL, "height_cm" INTEGER NULL, "ueln" TEXT NULL, "chip_number" TEXT NULL, "passport_number" TEXT NULL, "sire" TEXT NULL, "dam" TEXT NULL, "stable_location" TEXT NULL, "keeping_type" TEXT NULL, "owner" TEXT NULL, "insurance" TEXT NULL, "intolerances" TEXT NULL, "medical_history" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "profile_photo_id" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "horse_photos" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "horse_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES horses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "horse_weights" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "horse_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES horses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contacts" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "horse_contacts" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "horse_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES horses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "contact_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("horse_id", "contact_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "care_event_types" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "builtin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("builtin" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "care_interval_defaults" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "type_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_event_types (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "variant_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type_id", "variant_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "care_events" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "horse_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES horses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_event_types (id), "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), "variant_key" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "person" TEXT NULL, "cost_cents" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "fields" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "repeat_value" INTEGER NULL, "repeat_unit" TEXT NULL, "parent_event_id" TEXT NULL, "series_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "care_reminders" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "offset_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id", "offset_days"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shift_templates" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "short_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "end_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "stable_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "preferred_time" TEXT NULL, "is_night" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_night" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shift_patterns" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "steps" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "weeks" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shift_days" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shift_templates (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "override_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "other_person_covers" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("other_person_covers" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "pattern_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shift_patterns (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "training_plans" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "horse_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES horses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "goal" TEXT NOT NULL, "params" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "weeks" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "distributed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "training_sessions" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES training_plans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "horse_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES horses (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_key" TEXT NULL, "form" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned', "rating" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
